Home.heroKicker: Maghar, Sant Kabir Nagar, Uttar Pradesh
Home.heroHeadline: From the sacred land of Maghar, carrying forward Sant Kabir's message of humanity, equality and harmony
Home.heroSubtext: Where Sant Kabir Das Ji is said to have left his mortal body, Maghar remains a living symbol of his teachings — truth, love, equality and harmony among all faiths.
Home.introTitle: Who was Sant Kabir Das Ji?
Home.introBody: A saint, poet and social reformer of the 15th–16th century, Sant Kabir Das Ji used his dohas and verses to carry a message of devotion to truth and humanity that rose above caste, religion and empty ritual.
Home.magharBody: Maghar is the place where Sant Kabir Das Ji is traditionally believed to have left his mortal body around 1518 CE. According to tradition, his Samadhi and Mazar stand side by side here to this day — a living symbol of Hindu-Muslim harmony.
Home.mahantBody: Mahant Vichar Das Ji is a respected religious guide associated with Kabir Chaura in Maghar, publicly involved in programmes that carry forward Sant Kabir's message.
Home.eventsEmpty: No upcoming events are listed at the moment. Please check back soon.
Home.sadbhavTitle: A door open to every faith
Home.sadbhavBody: Kabir's verses are honoured across both Hindu and Muslim traditions. Maghar remains a living example of that same spirit of religious harmony, welcoming people of every faith.
